raw.notable_prerequisites:
The Reaver Cleaver attached to a creature with power four or greater that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block the creature with The Reaver Cleaver attached.
raw.steps:
Deal combat damage to a player with the creature that has The Reaver Cleaver attached.
The creature triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasure tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

raw.notable_prerequisites:
You control at least five in any combination of Assassins, Pirates and/or Vehicles.
You are able to tap at least five Assassins, Pirates and/or Vehicles you control each turn.
raw.steps:
Tap at least five Assassins, Pirates and/or Vehicles you control, either by declaring them as attackers if they don't have vigilance or by using any other method.
At the beginning of your end step, Edward Kenway's first ability triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

raw.notable_prerequisites:
You control at least five creatures with total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Luxurious Locomotive.
raw.steps:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive as an attacker.
Luxurious Locomotive triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

raw.easy_prerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
You have at least two opponents.
raw.notes: The combo stops creating enough Treasures once you have one opponent remaining. If you start the combo with three or more opponents, you will make additional Treasures each iteration, which you could use for extra iterations while you only have one opponent. Depending on the life totals of your opponents and your deck size, the combo may also stop once your library is empty.
raw.steps:
Declare Glint-Horn Buccaneer as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Glint-Horn Buccaneer by paying {1}{R} and discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Resolve the Glint-Horn Buccaneer ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

raw.notable_prerequisites:
Hoard Hauler does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Hoard Hauler and controls at least five artifacts.
You control a creature with power three or greater.
raw.steps:
Activate Hoard Hauler by tapping a creature with power three or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls five or more artifacts using Hoard Hauler.
Hoard Hauler triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

raw.notable_prerequisites: You control at least two Pirates that do not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by at least two opponents.
raw.notes: Once you only have one opponent remaining, this combo will no longer make the necessary resources to sustain itself.
raw.steps:
Deal combat damage to two opponents using at least two Pirates.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least two Treasure, Food and Clue tokens.
Activate TIme Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
